images.prompt:
Use case: lighting-weather. Asset type: premium illustrated companion-app seasonal home-table concept key art, one full-size landscape image, 16:9 at largest supported landscape resolution (reference is 1672x941). Input image is A1, the approved identity, camera, composition, furniture layout and rendering style reference. Create a seasonal lighting/weather edit of this exact A1 scene, not a redesign of the room. Invariants: same eye-level seated viewer camera and crop, partner half body centered across the small wooden table, same huge city window and fixed mullions, same city skyline and river, pleated practical lamp far left, same plants/books/vase left, sofa and sleeping cat back right, same CLOSED wooden record player at lower right, same table edges and instant photo lower right. Foreground at bottom center must keep the viewer Ayu's TWO anatomically clean hands holding his blue-grey ceramic mug, charcoal hoodie sleeves visible. Exactly ONE human across the table: Xiaoman, original woman early 20s, identical face to reference, chestnut shoulder-length softly tousled hair, wispy bangs, small gold STAR hair clip on viewer-right side, warm amber eyes, thin gold necklace, warm natural expression. No other human anywhere, no human reflections, no second couple. Style locked to the reference: high-end 2D anime CG illustration, semi-realistic anime proportions, clean fine lines, soft cel shading with painterly gradients, warm subsurface skin, highly detailed hair highlights, tactile fabric and wood, cinematic contrasting ambient and practical key light, restrained bloom/bokeh and depth separation. No photorealism, no 3D render, no chibi, no existing franchise resemblance. No UI, no writing or captions or logos, no outlines or glowing rings around objects, no halos or pin markers. Keep facial identity, perspective and furniture placement strictly stable; change only the requested lighting/weather, Xiaoman's natural pose/outfit and a few specified seasonal props.
Season LW-07 SPRING CHERRY BLOSSOM MORNING: dry, fresh spring morning, pale blue skyline and fresh green hints outdoors. Clear soft peach-white morning sunlight enters diagonally from upper left, subtly rosy bounce and clean cool airy fill from the open window; light and bright, not sunset orange. One side casement of the existing window is visibly OPEN, hinged without changing the fixed outer frame/mullions. A cherry blossom branch just outside that opening sheds a few beautifully defined pale pink petals: several drifting through the air, a few resting on the tabletop and two in her hair. Fine loose hair strands visibly lifted sideways by the gentle breeze. Xiaoman wears a light cream cardigan over white tee, thin gold necklace visible, leaning across with a soft attentive sideways-then-back glance, one hand loosely holding her floral mug and the other lightly near her cheek as in A1. Pleasant intimate spring mood, no extra objects. The left practical lamp is present but much less bright than daylight. Preserve all furniture positions and viewer's foreground charcoal hoodie/mug.
